parameters.jsCode: const result=$input.first().json; const stages=result.stage_results; if(result.next_route!=='human_approval'||result.groundedness_percent!==100) throw new Error('Run is not eligible for Human Approval'); return [{json:{schema_version:'1.0.0',run_id:result.run_id,extraction:stages.requirement_extraction.output,gap_analysis:stages.gap_analysis.output.gap_analysis,generation_gate:stages.gap_analysis.output.generation_gate,orchestration_context:{parent_trace_id:result.parent_trace_id,test_id:'T1',environment:'connected-canary'}}}];

const stage=$input.first().json; const mapped=$('Map Human Approval Input').first().json; const errors=[]; if(stage.run_id!==mapped.run_id) errors.push('run_id mismatch'); if(stage.stage!=='human_approval'||stage.execution_status!=='passed') errors.push('stage invalid'); if(stage.decision!=='continue'||stage.next_route!=='prd_generation') errors.push('T1 approval must route to prd_generation'); if(stage.groundedness_percent!==100) errors.push('groundedness must be 100'); if(stage.observability?.parent_trace_id!==mapped.orchestration_context.parent_trace_id) errors.push('parent trace mismatch'); if(!stage.observability?.ingestion_accepted) errors.push('Langfuse ingestion not accepted'); if(errors.length) throw new Error('Connected Human Approval canary failed: '+errors.join('; ')); return [{json:{schema_version:'1.0.0',result_type:'connected_human_approval_canary_result',run_id:mapped.run_id,test_id:'T1',execution_status:'passed',current_stage:'human_approval',next_route:'prd_generation',groundedness_percent:100,parent_trace_id:mapped.orchestration_context.parent_trace_id,human_approval_stage:stage,checks:{run_id_preserved:true,parent_trace_id_preserved:true,human_approval_passed:true,expected_route_reached:true,langfuse_ingestion_accepted:true},recorded_at:new Date().toISOString()}}];
const result=$input.first().json;const stage=result.human_approval_stage;if(!stage)throw new Error('Validated Human Approval stage missing');return [{json:stage}];

const stage=$input.first().json;const parent=$('Create T1 Parent Run').first().json;const errors=[];if(stage.schema_version!=='1.0.0')errors.push('schema_version');if(stage.run_id!==parent.run_id)errors.push('run_id mismatch');if(stage.stage!=='prd_generation'||stage.execution_status!=='passed'||stage.decision!=='continue'||stage.next_route!=='story_breakdown')errors.push('PRD stage route invalid');if(stage.groundedness_percent!==100)errors.push('groundedness must be 100');if(stage.observability?.parent_trace_id!==parent.orchestration_context.parent_trace_id)errors.push('parent trace mismatch');if(!stage.observability?.ingestion_accepted)errors.push('Langfuse ingestion not accepted');if(stage.output?.test_id!=='T11'||stage.output?.contract_status!=='passed')errors.push('T11 contract not passed');if(errors.length)throw new Error('Connected PRD Generation canary failed: '+errors.join('; '));return [{json:{schema_version:'1.0.0',result_type:'connected_prd_generation_canary_result',run_id:parent.run_id,test_id:'T1-to-T11',execution_status:'passed',current_stage:'prd_generation',next_route:'story_breakdown',groundedness_percent:100,parent_trace_id:parent.orchestration_context.parent_trace_id,prd_generation_stage:stage,checks:{run_id_preserved:true,parent_trace_id_preserved:true,prd_generation_passed:true,expected_route_reached:true,langfuse_ingestion_accepted:true},recorded_at:new Date().toISOString()}}];
const result=$input.first().json;const stage=result.prd_generation_stage;if(!stage)throw new Error('Validated PRD Generation stage missing');return [{json:stage}];

const stage=$input.first().json;const parent=$('Create T1 Parent Run').first().json;const errors=[];if(stage.schema_version!=='1.0.0')errors.push('schema_version');if(stage.run_id!==parent.run_id)errors.push('run_id mismatch');if(stage.stage!=='story_breakdown'||stage.execution_status!=='passed'||stage.decision!=='continue'||stage.next_route!=='final_validation')errors.push('Story Breakdown stage route invalid');if(stage.groundedness_percent!==100)errors.push('groundedness must be 100');if(stage.observability?.parent_trace_id!==parent.orchestration_context.parent_trace_id)errors.push('parent trace mismatch');if(!stage.observability?.ingestion_accepted)errors.push('Langfuse ingestion not accepted');if(stage.output?.test_id!=='T12'||stage.output?.contract_status!=='passed')errors.push('T12 contract not passed');if(stage.output?.validation?.canonical_t12_coverage!==true)errors.push('canonical T12 coverage not passed');if(errors.length)throw new Error('Connected Story Breakdown canary failed: '+errors.join('; '));return [{json:{schema_version:'1.0.0',result_type:'connected_story_breakdown_canary_result',run_id:parent.run_id,test_id:'T1-to-T12',execution_status:'passed',current_stage:'story_breakdown',next_route:'final_validation',groundedness_percent:100,parent_trace_id:parent.orchestration_context.parent_trace_id,story_breakdown_stage:stage,checks:{run_id_preserved:true,parent_trace_id_preserved:true,story_breakdown_passed:true,canonical_t12_coverage:true,expected_route_reached:true,langfuse_ingestion_accepted:true},recorded_at:new Date().toISOString()}}];
